lines.text: The sons of the prophets tell Elisha their meeting place is too small and ask to go to the Jordan for logs.
Elisha agrees to go with them, and at the Jordan they begin cutting down trees.
While one man is cutting down a tree, the iron axe head falls into the water, and he says it was borrowed.
Elisha asks where it fell, cuts a rope, throws it there, and makes the iron float.
Elisha tells the man to lift it out, and the man dives into the Jordan and takes it.
